description: Frozen ACMG benchmark set sampled from ClinVar for the Intra-LLM BioFilesystem evaluation.

filters.review_status_kept: criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts; reviewed by expert panel; practice guideline
filters.excluded: conflicting interpretations; non-tier significances (drug response, risk factor, etc.)

scoring_note: The truth label is used only for scoring and is never shown to an agent; agents receive gene, hgvs, and protein only.
